text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Pengecualian) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 8 April 2014.

Pengecualian

2. (1) Tertakluk kepada subperenggan (2), penjual borong yang menjual kepada

pembeli atau pembeli yang membeli daripada penjual borong, apa-apa barang berjadual

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual adalah dikecualikan daripada kehendak di bawah

subperaturan 9(2) Peraturan-Peraturan Kawalan Bekalan 1974 [P.U. (A) 103/1974].

(2) Penjualan atau pembelian apa-apa barang berjadual yang disebut dalam

subperenggan (1) hendaklah bagi maksud kegunaan sendiri pembeli itu sahaja.

(3) Dalam perenggan ini, "penjual borong" ertinya seseorang yang memegang

suatu lesen yang sah yang dikeluarkan di bawah Peraturan-Peraturan Kawalan

Bekalan 1974 untuk berniaga apa-apa barang berjadual secara borong.

JADUAL

BARANG BERJADUAL

1. Minyak tanah

2. Baja

3. Bar bulat keluli lembut

4. Simen

Dibuat 25 Mac 2014

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/5 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VII]

 DATO' SRI HASAN BIN MALEK

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

 Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (EXEMPTION) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5A of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Exemption)

Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 8 April 2014.

Exemption

2. (1) Subject to subparagraph (2), a wholesaler who sells to a purchaser or

a purchaser who purchases from a wholesaler, any scheduled article as specified in

the Schedule is exempted from the requirements under subregulation 9(2) of the

Control of Supplies Regulations 1974 [P.U. (A) 103/1974].

(2) The sale or purchase of any scheduled article referred to

in subparagraph (1) shall be for the purposes of the purchaser's personal use only.

(3) In this paragraph, "wholesaler" means a person holding a valid licence

issued under the Control of Supplies Regulations 1974 to deal in any scheduled article

by wholesale.

SCHEDULE

 SCHEDULED ARTICLE

1. Kerosene

2. Fertilizer

3. Mild steel round bars

4. Cement

Made 25 March 2014

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/5 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VII]

 DATO' SRI HASAN BIN MALEK

 Minister of Domestic Trade,

 Co-operatives and Consumerism
